settings.title: What's in the box
settings.content: WARCAT smart litter box (base, globe & sealed drawer), power adapter, starter liners, quick-start guide, and free access to the WARCAT app for iOS & Android.

settings.title: Dimensions & specs
settings.content: 26 × 27 × 29 in (66 × 68 × 73 cm). 90L globe. Cleaning noise under 40 dB. For cats 1–11 kg. 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. Works with any clumping clay or tofu litter — no proprietary refills.

settings.title: Setup & compatibility
settings.content: Setup takes about 10 minutes with no tools: place it, add litter, connect to Wi-Fi, pick your quiet hours. Most cats adapt within a week.

settings.title: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free 2-day shipping. Try it for 90 nights — if it's not for you, we'll arrange a free return and full refund. 2-year warranty.
